transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because after my cashier shifts, I keep buying these huge takeout orders—burgers, fries, chicken, desserts, like enough for a family. Then I sit there and eat almost all of it myself before I go home.
When this happens, do you feel unable to stop eating once you’ve started?
Yeah. Once I take that first bite, it’s like something clicks off. I’m telling myself, “Demetrius, stop, you don’t need any more,” but I just keep reaching for the next thing anyway.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit to try to undo the eating?
I’m not sure what you mean by that.
After you eat that much, do you ever make yourself throw up?
I… I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed myself doing that.
After one of these eating episodes, do you ever take laxatives to try to get rid of the food?
I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed myself taking anything like that after.
After these eating episodes, do you realize the whole time that you’re eating?

Yeah, I know I’m eating, but once I take that first bite, it’s like something clicks off. I’m telling myself, “Demetrius, stop, you don’t need more,” but my hands just keep reaching for the next thing.
After one of these eating episodes, do you ever realize you can’t remember parts of what you ate?
No, I usually remember what I ate. It’s more that I feel like I can’t stop while it’s happening.
After these eating episodes, do you ever exercise a lot to try to make up for the calories?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed myself doing that after.
Do these eating episodes upset you a lot afterward?
Yeah. I still make it to my cashier shifts, but afterward I’m spending money we don’t really have on food and hiding it from my wife. It makes things tense at home. I feel dishonest.
During one of these episodes, do you eat an unusually large amount of food for the amount of time?
Yeah. After my shifts, I’ll buy a huge takeout order—burgers, fries, chicken, desserts, like enough for a family—and eat almost all of it myself before I go home.
Do these eating episodes ever happen after you’ve fallen asleep and then gotten up during the night?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed getting up in the night to eat like that.
During these eating episodes, do you feel like you can’t control how much you eat?
Yeah. Once I take that first bite, it’s like something clicks off. Even when I’m telling myself, “Demetrius, stop, you don’t need more,” I just keep reaching for the next thing.
